names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 18 aprilie, «Sfântul Ierarh Cosma Mărturisitorul, Episcopul Calcedonului».

Read out of the calendar’s name link for 18 апреля ст. ст., which gives «Святитель Косма Халкидонский, епископ, исповедник»; Святитель, епископ and исповедник are rank words and are not part of the stored form, and the see stays in this folder’s `office` and display name.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 18 апреля ст. ст. — «Свт. Космы исп., еп. Халкидонского, и прп. Авксентия (815-820).»

attestations.note: His name page 1300 lists this one day and no other, and the day is the same as the `romanian` row’s 18 aprilie. The day page prints no hymn under his name; the two hymns it carries above his entry belong to the teacher of a neighbouring saint and the two below to an icon. The Russian is the first source read for this folder to give a year. azbyka.ru was not read.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 18 aprilie — «Sfântul Ierarh Cosma Mărturisitorul, Episcopul Calcedonului»

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru is the first source read for this folder to give any year: its life882 closes «Святитель Косма (+ ок. 815 - 820) и преподобный Авксентий до самой кончины незыблемо хранили православную веру», and the day’s own line prints the same pair of years as «(815-820)». The interval is the source’s own and nothing inside it is chosen; doxologia.ro gave no year for his birth, his consecration or his death.
